Method of Attack: Click-fraud malware that infects computers and clicks on invisible ads on the user's behalf; also distributes secondary payloads including Locky ransomware and Nemucod ransomware
Impacted Systems: Computers infected by Kovter click-fraud malware
Attack Vector: Spam campaigns distributing Kovter malware; spam emails sent via compromised websites (e.g., Joomla) running mailer scripts
